name: The Baumman Box
summary:
Your dead son can be resurrected with the power of the mysterious forest, yes. But the forest would rather add your body to its rotting collection.

Explore a dark entombed forest and collect mushrooms to successfully perform a ritual, and know that the forest is ready to stop you. Uncover the mystery of the confined woods as you avoid death in an attempt to save the life of a child. Find the truth of why you are here through the game's multiple endings.
